research_leads.title: Lowell Beveridge's education and marriage (author's family recollection)
research_leads.summary: The author recounts that his father Lowell attended Boston Latin School, received an A.B. from Harvard in 1925 at age 19, and later married Ida Louisa Gattrell.
research_leads.evidence: Family memoir. Establish corresponding identity and corroborate education and marriage with primary records before changing biographical dates.
